subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers repair this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a broader sibling candidate instead?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same approval prompt bug, and this branch still has concrete source blockers plus a contributor proof gap, so choosing the canonical landing branch needs maintainer coordination.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, fix the embedded parser and native Telegram coverage, then require real prompt proof before treating it as canonical.

options.title: Promote a sibling candidate
options.body: Choose a broader proof-positive sibling PR as the canonical fix and preserve this PR's useful context there.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, fix the embedded parser and native Telegram coverage, then require real prompt proof before treating it as canonical.
